evidence.claim: Passing mechanics and agreement among agents do not establish real-table accuracy.

protocol.initial: Natural roll prescribed at geometric rail contact, with sidespin
protocol.output: Immediate state and first actual pure roll sampled after contact; first-roll time uncertainty is at most the sampling step (not an exact transition instant)
protocol.signedConventions: normalMps is positive away from the selected cushion (negative incident); tangentMps and rubberTangentialSlipMps use canonical +x; angleFromOutwardNormalDeg is signed atan2(tangent,outward normal), including incident values in [90,180]; incident also reports angleFromIncomingNormalDeg
